chart_check.similarity_reason: The rendered chart is poorly consistent. claim_check.reason: The chart does not explicitly label any of its data as 'crime rate'. Even if one of the bar charts is assumed to represent this, the data does not support the claim. Therefore, the claim that the East of England had the highest rate is contradicted by the visual information.
